name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
oracle_text:
Flash
At the beginning of your end step, draw seven cards.
Each opponent's maximum hand size is reduced by seven.
blocked_sentences: Each opponent's maximum hand size is reduced by seven.

needs.what: a player-wide static that ADDS a signed amount to the named players' maximum hand size ("reduced by seven", "increased by one" -- Spellbook-style modifiers), applied in 613.11 timestamp order on top of whatever the newest setting effect left (7 by default, a set number from a `maximum_hand_size` static), floored at 0, and having no effect on a player with no maximum hand size
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The `maximum_hand_size` static only SETS the size (Twenty-Toed Toad's "is twenty") and `player_statics.maximum_hand_size` picks the newest single effect; writing it as 'is 0' for opponents would wrongly override an opponent's older Reliquary Tower / no_maximum_hand_size, and would give 0 instead of 13 against an older 'is twenty'. There is no additive hand-size adjustment.
